Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) demonstrates a distinct, rounded hyperdense mass located in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, which corresponds anatomically to the right middle lobe. This lesion is positioned laterally and appears to exert mild mass effect on the adjacent pulmonary structures, consistent with the description of a pseudoaneurysm causing mild displacement of the right lower lobe bronchus.
